query: WITH entities AS ((SELECT id FROM sandboxes WHERE project_id = $1 AND name = $2 AND (id > $4) AND ($4 IS NOT NULL) AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT $3) UNION ALL (SELECT id FROM sandboxes WHERE project_id = $1 AND name = $2 AND ($4 IS NULL) AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT $3) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT $3) SELECT i.id AS "entity_id!: Repo__Id", e.sequence, e.event, CASE WHEN $5 THEN e.context ELSE NULL::jsonb END as "context: es_entity::ContextData", e.recorded_at, NULL::jsonb as "forgettable_payload?" FROM entities i JOIN sandbox_events e ON i.id = e.id ORDER BY i.id asc, i.id, e.sequence
